item.title: Advancing towards a Responsible and Resilient Digital Future
item.content:encoded:
Imon Chakraborty, Indian Institute of Technology Madras

Saji K. Mathew, Indian Institute of Technology Madras

Nargis Pervin, Indian Institute of Technology Madras

Viswanath Venkatesh, Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

Digital technologies such as AI and platforms deliver significant value but also introduce serious challenges including bias, privacy violations, and workforce disruption. This special issue seeks research on information systems that are both responsible—fair, transparent, and accountable—and resilient—able to withstand disruptions and continue functioning effectively.

The special issue welcomes theoretically grounded research using various methods including conceptual work, surveys, experiments, case studies, and design science approaches. It seeks insights beyond simple adoption narratives, exploring post-adoption use, value realization, human-machine collaboration, AI governance, and long-term societal impacts.

The special issue is linked to the India Conference on Information Systems 2027 but is open to all authors. Submissions should challenge existing paradigms and clearly identify the specific technologies examined. Papers must have IS, behavioral, organizational, or societal contributions rather than purely technical focus.

Appel publié par Information Systems Frontiers. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

  • Responsible AI and AI Governance
  • Resilient Information Systems and Digital Platforms
  • Human–AI Collaboration and Decision Making
  • Digital Transformation and Innovation
  • User Behaviour in Digital Environment
  • Digital Trust, Privacy, and Cybersecurity
  • Data Governance and AI-Enabled Decision Making
  • Digital Inclusion, Accessibility, and Societal Impact
  • Policy and Governance of Digital Technologies
  • Design Science Research for Responsible and Resilient IS
  • AI and future of work and education
  • Opportunities and challenges of AI for society
  • Skills and mindsets unique to humans in an AI-driven world
